newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Somalia's powerful faction leaders meet.
newsitem.headline: Somalia's powerful faction leaders meet.

text.p: Somalia's two most powerful faction leaders Hussein Aideed and Ali Mahdi Mohamed started their first face-to-face talks on Monday, officials said.

The two leaders met at a hotel along Mogadishu's Greenline, which separates the divided city into the north controlled by Ali Mahdi and the south by Aideed. Officials said talks centred on reopening Mogadishu port and airport, closed since 1995 because of feuds between the two factions.
